name: FREAKSHOW LABS | PORTO
description: FREAKSHOW LABS | PORTO is a stand-up comedy event featuring tests of new material. The show has a duration of 75 minutes with no intermission.
longDescription:
FREAKSHOW LABS | PORTO presents an evening of stand-up comedy at Ferro Bar in Porto. The event, scheduled for November 26, 2026, at 8:30 PM, focuses on testing new stand-up material.

The show runs for 75 minutes without an intermission. Tickets are priced at €12.

This event is open to individuals aged 16 and over. The venue is located at R. da Madeira 84, 4000-427 Porto.
